entities.summary: Luis Olaso Anabitarte was a Spanish footballer who played as a midfielder. Born in Villabona, Guipúzcoa, Olaso played for Atlético Madrid and Real Madrid. He played four matches for the Spain national team from 1921 to 1927, scoring one goal. His brother Alfonso also played for Atlético and Spain in the same period.
